name: 8085 16-bit Multiplication
desc: This program performs a binary multiplication of a 16-bit number by an 8-bit number using the Shift-and-Add method. Specifically, it multiplies the 16-bit multiplicand stored at 9000H by the 8-bit multiplier stored at 9002H, saving the 16-bit result at 9003H

files.sketch.ino:
;write an ALP to multiply two 8 bit number by shift and add method.

ORG 8000H
8000: LHLD 9000H    ; Load 16-bit Multiplicand into HL pair (HL = 0008H)
8003: XCHG          ; Copy Multiplicand to DE pair (DE = 0008H)
8004: LDA 9002H     ; Load 8-bit Multiplier into Accumulator (A = AAH)
8007: LXI H, 0000H  ; Clear HL pair to accumulate the partial product (HL = 0000H)
800A: MVI C, 08H    ; Initialize loop counter for 8 bits (C = 08H)

LOOP: 
800C: DAD H         ; Shift HL (partial product) left by 1 bit (Multiply by 2)
800D: RAL           ; Rotate Accumulator (multiplier) left through Carry
800E: JNC 8012H     ; If Carry = 0, skip the addition (Jump to NEXT)
8011: DAD D         ; If Carry = 1, add Multiplicand (DE) to Partial Product (HL)

NEXT: 
8012: DCR C         ; Decrement bit counter
8013: JNZ 800CH     ; If C != 0, repeat loop for next bit
8016: SHLD 9003H    ; Store final 16-bit product at memory 9003H-9004H
8019: HLT           ; Halt execution

; --- Data Section ---
ORG 9000H
9000: DB 08H        ; Lower byte of Multiplicand
9001: DB 00H        ; Higher byte of Multiplicand (Combined: 0008H)
9002: DB AAH        ; 8-bit Multiplier
